name: openscad-part
about: An OpenSCAD model (model.scad) that renders to a closed solid whose bounding box is your size X,Y,Z in millimetres (within tol; in that axis order unless orientation is any) and, if you give it, whose volume is yours within vol_tol. Measured on the rendered STL, not read from the source. Proves the part renders, is printable as a solid and has the right envelope and amount of material; not that every feature sits in the right place.
instructions: Reply with model.scad only: one solid part, units millimetres, no include, use or import of other files. Give round features $fn = 64 or more. Keep bodies overlapping, not just touching, so the result is one closed solid.

size.about: the bounding box in mm as X,Y,Z, e.g. 60,40,4

tol.about: how far each side may be from size, in mm

orientation.about: fixed (X,Y,Z in that order) or any (the three sides in any order)

volume.about: the part's volume in mm³, computed by you (empty: not checked); catches a missing hole or a pocket that doesn't go through

vol_tol.about: relative tolerance on volume; round features drawn with facets lose a little
